definition: A compensation component that continues rather than ending after one payment.
analytical_unit: deduplicated municipality × compensation cycle × compensation mechanism × side implementation event
caption: This map shows 720 distinct documented recurring implementation events across 515 municipalities in 35 states. A compensation component that continues rather than ending after one payment. The geography matters because it locates the process in the retained evidence. Darker areas contain more events, not more workers or larger wage effects, and the map is not a national prevalence estimate.
